description: The file defines the ChainCache class which implements a caching mechanism that chains multiple cache objects together. It handles generating cache keys, writing, loading, retrieving timestamps, and removing cache entries across multiple cache adapters, facilitating layered caching.

classes.name: ChainCache
classes.description: A class that manages multiple cache layers by chaining them, enabling cache fetch, write, and delete operations across multiple cache backends.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a composite cache key based on class name and item name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to all caches in the chain, generating appropriate keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load cache data from caches in order until found or all caches have been tried.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp of the cache item from the cache layers.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries from all caches that support removal.

methods.name: splitKey
methods.description: Splits a cache key into its constituent parts for internal processing.
